evidence.approach: Use graphify's own installers rather than reimplementing any of them: claude install and install --platform codex for the assistants, hook install for the post-commit and post-checkout rebuild, and graphify-mcp registered as a project-scoped MCP server so both assistants query the same graph. Build the graph with the deterministic code pass, commit graphify-out/ so a fresh clone has context before its first build, and add one thin harness command, graph, that runs a graphify verb and appends its answer to the journal as a note carrying the hash of the graph that answered.
changes: harness/graph.py: new, maps the four modes (impact, path, explain, prs) to graphify verbs, runs one subprocess and returns the answer with the graph hash
harness/cli.py: the graph subcommand, its arguments and its dispatch
harness/paths.py: the graph output directory and the graph file location
harness/tests/test_graph.py: new, covers the wrapper against a stub graphify on PATH
.github/workflows/ci.yml: a graphify extract --code-only step that fails when the graph does not parse and uploads GRAPH_REPORT.md
CLAUDE.md: the graphify section the tool writes, edited into the file's voice
.mcp.json: the project-scoped graphify-mcp server both assistants read
graphify-out/: the committed graph, report and labels
.gitignore: keep graphify's local caches out while keeping graph.json in
tests_first: harness graph SEEN-087 impact --about 'stage gate' appends a note record whose data carries the mode, the command, the exit code and the graph hash: harness/tests/test_graph.py, and the RED must fail on there being no graph module to import
harness graph refuses a mode outside impact, path, explain and prs and names the ones it accepts: the RED must fail because every mode is accepted
harness graph refuses when graphify-out/graph.json is absent, rather than recording an empty answer: the RED must fail because a missing graph records a note anyway
harness graph records the answer even when graphify exits non-zero, because a failed query is a fact about the work: the RED must fail because the non-zero exit raises instead of recording
alternatives: Call the graphify MCP server from the harness rather than the CLI, rejected because the harness is a procedure that launches no model and the MCP server is for the assistant's own queries, not for a shell command
Reimplement impact traversal over graph.json inside the harness, rejected because it duplicates graphify and would drift from it silently
Leave graphify-out/ out of the repository, rejected by the ticket: a fresh clone must have context before its first build
risks: The committed graph is a large JSON file that changes on most commits and will collide on merges; mitigated by graphify's own union merge driver, which hook install configures

graphify is a third-party tool at version 0.9.65 with a moving CLI; mitigated by the wrapper being thin, by recording the exact command in the journal, and by the version being pinned in the solution record rather than assumed
The PreToolUse hook graphify installs runs on every tool call; mitigated by reviewing what it writes into CLAUDE.md and settings before committing it
evidence.rollback: graphify uninstall removes the assistant wiring and the hooks, and reverting the commit removes the harness command and the CI step. Nothing in the product depends on the graph.
new_dependencies: graphifyy 0.9.65, installed as a uv tool outside the repository, not a package dependency of the monorepo
